highlights: UGREEN 45000 6-in-1 USB C Hub with 4K@60Hz HDMI, 100W PD, Gigabit Ethernet, 2x USB-A 10Gbps, USB-C 10Gbps
High-Speed 10Gbps Data Transfer: Equipped with two USB-A 3.2 and one USB-C 3.2 port, all supporting blazing 10 Gbps speeds for transferring large files in seconds to external drives and peripherals.

Stable Wired Gigabit Ethernet: Features an RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet port for a stable, high-speed wired internet connection, essential for lag-free online gaming, seamless video calls, and large downloads.
Powerful 100W Pass-Through Charging: The dedicated USB-C PD input supports up to 100W of power delivery, allowing you to charge your laptop at full speed while using all the hub's other functions.
Sharp 4K HDMI Display Output: Connect to an external monitor, projector, or HDTV and enjoy crystal-clear video at 4K@60Hz resolution, perfect for presentations, design work, and media streaming.

Compact & Durable Aluminum Body: Its sleek, lightweight aluminum casing ensures excellent heat dissipation and durability, making it the perfect portable companion for professionals and students on the go.
Data Ports: 2x USB-A 3.2 (10 Gbps), 1x USB-C 3.2 (10 Gbps)
Network Port: RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet (10/100/1000 Mbps)
